data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to embed Crisp live‑chat on Android, iOS, Web and desktop.
data.what_it_does: It wraps the official Crisp SDKs and web chat widget, exposing a Dart API to open the chat, configure user data, show local messages and trigger bot scenarios. The same API works across mobile, web and desktop platforms.
use_when: You need a ready‑made live‑chat solution powered by Crisp across all Flutter targets
You want iOS video/audio call support built‑in without extra code
avoid_when: You require a custom chat UI or a different chat provider
You need extensive offline messaging or storage
strengths: Cross‑platform (mobile, web, desktop) with a single API
Supports native SDK features like iOS video calls and local operator messages
weaknesses: Tied to the Crisp service only
iOS video calls only; Android lacks this feature
Requires native setup (permissions, Info.plist, Android manifest)
data.setup_notes: Add INTERNET permission on Android, set compileSdk/minSdk, add NSCameraUsageDescription and NSMicrophoneUsageDescription (and Photo Library) to iOS Info.plist, ensure iOS deployment target >=14 and Xcode 16.3+, include desktop_webview_window for desktop/web.
